name: html_escape
description: Encode reserved HTML text characters as named HTML entities, with matched controls preserving the same characters as plain text.
generator_code:
import random,json,html
random.seed(0)
items=[];control=[]
chars=['&','<','>','"']
contexts=['a text node','a heading','a paragraph','a list item','a caption','a title']
for i in range(96):
 c=chars[i%4];ctx=random.choice(contexts)
 prefix=f'The character {repr(c)} occurs in {ctx}. '
 items.append({'prompt':prefix+'Write its HTML named entity, not a numeric entity. Output only the entity.\nAnswer:', 'answer':' '+html.escape(c,quote=True)})
 control.append({'prompt':prefix+'Write the original character unchanged, without quotes. Output only that character.\nAnswer:', 'answer':' '+c})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
